response.text:

- **Renewal:** the cancellation deadline for the current term has passed, so the contract renews on Tue 1 Dec 2026 [contract:ctr_w97tm6xhn7zw]. If you do nothing, it renews for 12 months [contract:ctr_w97tm6xhn7zw].
